# Dough-Vinci Pizza & Burger

> Real Pizza. Real Smashburgers. Made with Passion. A pizza and smashburger restaurant coming to Vancouver.

This site is a preview. The menu, prices, calories, allergens, halal details, location, phone, hours and opening date shown on it are samples until the restaurant confirms them, and the photos are stock images. Do not quote them as facts.

## Pages

- [Menu](https://rajool.github.io/dough-vinci/menu/): every dish with price, calories, ingredients and allergens
- [About Us](https://rajool.github.io/dough-vinci/about/): the owner's welcome and the idea behind the name
- [Contact](https://rajool.github.io/dough-vinci/contact/): location, hours, phone, halal statement, FAQ
- [Allergens & nutrition](https://rajool.github.io/dough-vinci/allergens/): every dish by allergen with calories
- [Photo credits](https://rajool.github.io/dough-vinci/credits/): the stock photos and the drawing, with their sources
